name: avalang
description: Syntax highlighting for the AvaLang scripting language (.ava files)

avalang.executablePath.description: Path to the ava_cli executable used by "AvaLang: Run File" (F5 / play button). Can be just the name if it's on the PATH (e.g. "ava_cli"), or an absolute/relative path (e.g. "/path/to/avalang/build_cli/runtime/avalang/Release/ava_cli" or "C:/path/to/avalang/build_cli/runtime/avalang/Release/ava_cli.exe"). Supports ${workspaceFolder} and ${fileDirname}.

avalang.workingDirectory.description: Working directory ava_cli is launched from. Supports ${workspaceFolder}, ${fileDirname}, ${fileBasename}, ${fileBasenameNoExtension}, ${file}. Defaults to the folder of the .ava file being run.

avalang.modulesPath.description: Optional override for the modules/ folder (equivalent to ava_cli's --modules flag / the AVA_MODULES_PATH environment variable). Empty = use ava_cli's default (modules/ next to the executable).

avalang.args.description: Extra arguments appended after the script (available in AvaLang as the global `args` list).

avalang.clearTerminalBeforeRun.description: Clear the AvaLang terminal before each run with F5 / the play button.

avalang.build.repoRoot.description: Root of the AvaLang repo (equivalent to ava_cli build --repo-root). Empty = auto-detect by walking up from the workspace folder looking for CMakeLists.txt + runtime/avapack/CMakeLists.txt.

avalang.build.outDir.description: Output folder for "AvaLang: Build Executable..." (ava_cli build --out). Supports ${workspaceFolder}, ${fileDirname}.

avalang.build.compilerPathDesktop.description: ava_cli build --compiler-path used when the 'desktop' target is picked: a folder with cmake/ninja/gcc/g++/cl.exe, prepended to PATH for that build. Empty = rely on the system PATH.

avalang.build.compilerPathBarekernel.description: ava_cli build --compiler-path used when the 'barekernel' target is picked: the i686-elf toolchain root (i686-elf-gcc/g++/ld/objcopy/nm), searched recursively. Required for that target.

avalang.build.keyFile.description: Optional path to a 32-byte AES-256 key file (ava_cli build --key-file, desktop target only). Empty = a random key is generated per build.

avalang.diagnostics.enable.description: Show compile errors as red squiggly lines in the editor, using `ava_cli --check`. Disable if ava_cli isn't reachable and the noise from failed checks is unwanted.

avalang.diagnostics.runOn.description: When to re-check the file for errors: "onSave" (default, checks the real file on disk), "onType" (checks a temporary copy of the buffer as you type, debounced by diagnostics.debounceMs), or "off".

avalang.diagnostics.debounceMs.description: Milliseconds to wait after the last keystroke before re-checking, when avalang.diagnostics.runOn is "onType".

avalang.inlayHints.enable.description: Master switch for inline hints (inferred/annotated types and parameter names). Disable to turn off all AvaLang inlay hints.

avalang.inlayHints.types.description: Show inline type hints for variables/attributes whose type was inferred (not written with "as Type"), and for function/method return types inferred from their return statements.

avalang.inlayHints.parameterNames.description: Show inline parameter name hints at call sites (functions, methods, constructors, and builtins), skipped when the call already uses named-argument syntax or the argument is a variable with the same name as the parameter.

avalang.completion.constructorSnippets.description: When completing a class name, insert a snippet with tab stops for the constructor's real parameters (e.g. Robot(name)) instead of just the class name.

avalang.format.enable.description: Enable AvaLang's basic document formatter (re-indents every line based on if/while/for/func/class/try/select/extern nesting and their then/end/elif/else/catch/finally/case clauses). Disable if you use another tool to format .ava files.
